observations.description: Argentina recover the ball near their own penalty area.
Argentina move the ball forward with France players advanced.
Messi redirects the ball near halfway to continue the counterattack.
Alvarez releases Mac Allister into the open right channel.
Mac Allister squares towards Di Maria in the left side of the box.
Di Maria finishes past Lloris. The ball is in the net and Argentina celebrate.
Di Maria celebrates and the score graphic reads Argentina 2, France 0.

lines.text: France have pushed up. There is space behind them.
One-touch football, all the way through. A brilliant team goal.
